'''R5-K6''' was an [[R5 series astromech droid|R5 unit]] that served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]'s [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. Based on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]], the [[droid]] was part of the forces scrambled to [[Battle of Scarif|engage]] the Empire in the [[Scarif system]] while a [[Rogue One|Rebel strike team]] attempted to steal the [[Death Star plans]] on the [[planet]] [[Scarif]] below. R5-K6 flew with [[Red Leader]] [[Garven Dreis]] in a [[Red One (T-65B X-wing starfighter)|T-65B X-wing starfighter]] and engaged enemies [[starship]]s in [[Realspace|space]] while the strike team successfully stole the plans, after which R5-K6 and Dreis retreated.

Shortly after the plans were stolen, the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] traveled to the [[Yavin system]] to destroy the [[Great Temple|Rebel base]] and Yavin 4 entirely. R5-K6 once again flew with Dreis as part of the forces that attacked the [[Death Star]], engaging enemy [[starfighter]]s while the [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]]s of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]] attempted to exploit the vulnerable [[thermal exhaust port]] that the Alliance had learned about from the Death Star plans. After Gold Squadron were mostly destroyed, R5-K6 and Dreis made an attack run on the port themselves, but failed to hit their target, after which the pair were [[Death|killed]] when the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] destroyed their [[T-65B X-wing starfighter|X-wing starfighter]].

==Biography==
===Red Rebel===
R5-K6<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Black Series|pack=R2-A3, R5-K6, & R2-F2|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/R2-A3-R5-K6-R2-F2-The-Black-Series-6-Inch-Hasbro-Star-Wars.asp}}</ref> was an [[R5 series astromech droid|R5 unit]] [[astromech droid]]<ref name="ANH" /> manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]]<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> that served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. The [[droid]] was part of the [[Massassi Group]] based out of the [[Great Temple]], the Alliance's headquarters on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]. It flew with the [[pilot]] [[Garven Dreis]], who flew in his [[Red One (T-65B X-wing starfighter)|T-65B X-wing starfighter]] as [[Red Leader]] of the [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps]]' [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]].<ref name="ANH" />

===Battle of Scarif===
[[File:R5K6-BYOR2-79.png|thumb|left|250px|R5-K6 flew with Garven Dreis at Scarif.]]
In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Scarif date">{{FilmDate|RO|R5-K6's appearance}}</ref> the Rebel forces at Yavin were scrambled when it was discovered that a [[Rogue One|Rebel strike team]] had disobeyed orders and infiltrated the [[Imperial Center of Military Research|Imperial security complex]] on the [[planet]] [[Scarif]] in order to steal the [[Death Star plans|plans]] to the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]]. Red [[Squadron]], including Dreis and R5-K6, were amongst the forces that accompanied [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]] to the [[Scarif system]] in order to try and support the strike team.<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

Upon arriving in the [[star system]], the Rebels immediately [[Battle of Scarif|engaged]] the Imperial forces present above the planet. R5-K6 and the rest of Red Squadron fought alongside [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]] in engaging the Imperial [[starship]]s in [[Realspace|space]] while [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]] attempted to enter the planet's [[atmosphere]] to provide air support. Despite taking heavy loses, the Rebels were ultimately victorious and managed to successfully steal the plans before the surviving forces, including Dreis and R5-K6, retreated.<ref name="Rogue One" />

===Battle of Yavin===
[[File:Garven_Dreis_Databank.jpg|thumb|right|250px|R5-K6 with Dreis at the Battle of Yavin]]
Shortly after the Battle of Scarif, the Empire learned the location of the Rebel's base on Yavin 4 and sent the [[Death Star]] to the [[Yavin system]] in order to destroy it. In preparation for the battle, [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]] gave a briefing to rebel pilots in the temple covering the Death Star's vulnerable [[thermal exhaust port]]. R5-K6 attended the meeting, standing beside the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]]. Armed with the knowledge of the Death Star's weakness, R5-K6 and Dreis once again launched as part of Red Squadron alongside Gold Squadron in order to try and destroy the superweapon looming above the moon before it could destroy the moon itself. Dreis and the rest of Red Squadron initially attempted to draw fire from the Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s and [[turret]] emplacement, so that the [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]]s of Gold Squadron could attempt to hit the Death Star's vulnerable [[thermal exhaust port]].<ref name="ANH" />

[[File:Dreis_dies.png|thumb|left|250px|R5-K6 died alongside Dreis in the Battle of Yavin.]]
After most of Gold Squadron was destroyed however, Dreis and R5-K6 made an attack run on the port themselves with two wingmen. Both other pilots were [[Death|killed]] in the attempt, and although Dreis made the shot it only impacted on the surface of the Death Star rather than entering the port. Dreis and R5-K6 were then also killed when the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] shot down their craft himself, causing it to crash into the surface of the Death Star and explode. Ultimately Red Squadron was able to destroy the Death Star and win the battle.<ref name="ANH" />

==Description==
R5-K6 had [[Color|red]], black, and white paneling<ref name="BYO R2" /> and black [[sensor]]s.<ref name="ANH" /> Like all R5 units of the [[R-series]], it stood 97 [[centimeter]]s tall.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
R5-K6 first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> Footage of Dreis and R5-K6 originally shot for ''A New Hope'' was then used in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology film]], ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Rogue One" /> In the current [[canon]], the droid was first identified on an action figure set from the ''[[Star Wars: The Black Series]]'' released in [[2018]] by [[Hasbro]]<ref name="Hasbro" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in a [[2009]] Hasbro action figure set titled "Scramble on Yavin."<ref name="Scramble">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Legacy Collection|packtype=Battle Pack|pack=Scramble on Yavin|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TLCBPScrambleonYavin.asp}}</ref>
